name: jokbo
description: The reader of the LLM-development era.

interface.shortDescription: The reader of the LLM-development era.
interface.longDescription: The reader of the LLM-development era. Records are written faster than anyone reads them, and the next agent has no memory; what fails is not finding but knowing what to read, when, and how far to trust it. jokbo answers with where to read — the net if there is one, else the documents; the runs if there are any, else git — at the moment the question arises, and says how current each source is. It never decides and never becomes a source.
